```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(srvyr)
```

```{r Survey Data Setup}
df <- read.csv("RHFS_2024_Public_Variables.csv")

df <- df |> 
  select(-REPWGT0) |> # REPWGT0 is equivalent to WEIGHT
  as_survey_rep(
    repweights = starts_with("REPWGT"), 
    weights = WEIGHT, 
    type = "successive-difference", 
    combined_weights = TRUE, 
    mse = TRUE # needs to be carefully checked
  )
```

```{r EDA}
# No explicit NAs
sum(is.na(df))
```
